verdict.rationale: Sumsub's docs cover each step of the story. Server-side access-token generation feeds WebSDK initialization (a React package is available) for the embedded path, and WebSDK permalinks cover the hosted redirect path. Verification levels combine document and selfie/liveness steps, and results come back via webhooks, WebSDK event messages and the REST API, all testable in Sandbox. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the integration, and explicit documentation of the result-retrieval API endpoint (only general API statements).
